question: What is the meaning of portion of product released into the environment during use in relation to product portion released into the environment during its use?
data_group: product portion released into the environment during its use
data_point: portion of product released into the environment during use
description:
The portion of product released into the environment during use refers to the part of the product that is released into the environment during its use phase. This is a mandatory statement in ISO 59040:2025 and is expressed in accordance with range 1 defined in 6.2. It is a measure of the product's environmental impact during its use phase.
